system.description:
Usable only on those who have accepted the gift of Ending the Watch, this power draws upon the psychic echoes a newly dead soul leaves behind in the chamber of its passing, granting the Salubri strength or knowledge from the departed.

System: By spending a Willpower and rolling Perception + Empathy, the player can merge the departed spirit with the Salubri's own, granting a chance (Intelligence, difficulty 5) to know any fact the dead person knew. Alternately, letting the mind drift and rolling Perception + Empathy (difficulty 7) may surface useful details unbidden. The Salubri may instead draw in the remaining essence of the departed soul entirely: for each success originally obtained on the Ending the Watch roll, the player rolls one die (difficulty 6), each success healing a level of damage, though this permanently drains the departed's essence. Watching the Passage can only be used within a week of the mortal's death. A botch inflicts a level of aggravated damage and may summon a malefic spirit.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
